raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
When using `/v1/audio/transcriptions`, the Whisper-compatible `language` parameter was ignored because `get_generation_prompt` only checked `to_language` and never fell back to `language`.

This adds a fallback so that when `to_language` is `None`, the `language` parameter is used instead, allowing the Whisper-compatible `language` field to correctly inject the language prefill into the assistant prompt.

Fixes: #33768



## Purpose

Fix `Qwen3-ASR` ignoring the Whisper-compatible `language` parameter when using the `/v1/audio/transcriptions` endpoint (fixes #33768).

In `get_generation_prompt`, only `to_language` was checked and `language` was never used as a fallback, causing the model to always auto-detect the language regardless of what was passed by the user.

One-line fix: fall back to `stt_params.language` when `stt_params.to_language` is `None`:

```python
# before
to_language = stt_params.to_language

# after
to_language = stt_params.to_language or stt_params.language
```

The same bug was independently identified and fixed in the upstream qwen-asr package: [[QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR#101](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR/pull/101)](https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR/pull/101), confirming this is the correct approach.

## Test Plan

```bash
# Download test audio (English speech)
wget https://qianwen-res.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/Qwen3-ASR-Repo/asr_en.wav -O /tmp/test.wav

# Serve the model
vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B --port 9000

# Test with different language parameters
curl -X POST http://localhost:9000/v1/audio/transcriptions \
  -F "file=@/tmp/test.wav" \
  -F "model=Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B" \
  -F "language=zh" \
  -F "response_format=json"
```

## Test Result

Tested with `Qwen/Qwen3-ASR-1.7B` on the same English audio file with different `language` values:

**Before fix** (`language` parameter ignored, always returns English regardless):

`language=en`:
```json
{"text":"Uh huh. Oh yeah, yeah. He wasn't even that big when I started listening to him, but and his solo music didn't do overly well, but he did very well when he started writing for other people.","usage":{"type":"duration","seconds":16}}
```

`language=de`:
```json
{"text":"Uh huh. Oh yeah, yeah. He wasn't even that big when I started listening to him, but and his solo music didn't do overly well, but he did very well when he started writing for other people.","usage":{"type":"duration","seconds":16}}
```

`language=zh`:
```json
{"text":"Uh huh. Oh yeah, yeah. He wasn't even that big when I started listening to him, but and his solo music didn't do overly well, but he did very well when he started writing for other people.","usage":{"type":"duration","seconds":16}}
```

**After fix:**

`language=en`:
```json
{"text":"Uh huh. Oh yeah, yeah. He wasn't even that big when I started listening to him, but and his solo music didn't do overly well, but he did very well when he started writing for other people.","usage":{"type":"duration","seconds":16}}
```

`language=de`:
```json
{"text":"Oh ja, ja. Er war nicht einmal so groß, als ich anfing, ihn zu hören. Aber und seine Solo-Musik hat nicht besonders gut geklappt, aber er hat sehr gut gemacht, als er anfing, für andere zu schreiben.","usage":{"type":"duration","seconds":16}}
```

`language=zh`:
```json
{"text":"嗯，哦， yeah, yeah. He wasn't even that big when I started listening to him, but and his solo music didn't do overly well, but he did very well when he started writing for other people.","usage":{"type":"duration","seconds":16}}
```
